basic_info.description: Welcome to residence #401 at The Sutterfield-a light-filled 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offering style, comfort, and convenience in one of San Francisco's most central locations.     With approximately 801 square feet of comfortable living space, this home features a freshly updated kitchen with sleek new countertops, perfect for cooking and entertaining. Oversized windows flood the rooms with natural light, while multiple closets throughout the home provide abundant storage. Complete with in-unit laundry for added ease.     Residents enjoy resort-style amenities, including a fitness center, sauna, an outdoor hot tub and concierge service. The building features secure garage access with an assigned parking space and full-service doorman security.  Located at the intersection of Cathedral Hill, Japantown, and Lower Pacific Heights, The Sutterfield puts you steps from cafes, shops, dining, and transit options.     Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizing, or looking for a pied--terre, this bright and updated condo checks all the boxes.
